description: One tool on Toolaby (Test). Read it before changing it. freePlan says what the Free plan holds (freePlan.holds, in a sentence); features are the keys gate({ feature }) takes; plans say what each unlocks (plans[].features), with the id openPaymentPage(id) and data-toolaby-plan take; toolKey is what toolaby.config.js must hold (else `npx -y toolaby@latest upgrade <id>`); extension.checkedInAt says whether a copy has checked in; sale says whether anything can be bought, as the dashboard says it (label, and fix: stripe or price); pages.buyer is the checkout page, pages.webScript the <script src> of toolaby-web.js for a website, pages.api the REST API's base on this side.

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_get_tool
title: Read a tool
